feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Find the latest business news with reports on Wall Street, interest rates, banking, companies, and U.S. and world financial markets. Subscribe to the Business Story of the Day podcast.

entry.title: The Fed is expected to raise interest rates for the first time in 3 years
entry.summary: The Fed is widely expected to raise its benchmark interest rate to combat stubborn inflation. That could make it more expensive to borrow money to buy a car or carry a balance on a credit card.

entry.title: When students attend these colleges, taxpayers often pay. Here's why
entry.summary: Federal data shows many borrowers who aren't paying their loans went to private, for-profit colleges — schools that often market to low-income students and rely on federal financial aid for revenue.

entry.title: Turkish habit of stashing gold "under the pillow' hurts economy, government says
entry.summary: For years, Turks have stashed their gold at home against a raining day, mistrustful of banks. Now the government says that tradition hurts the economy

entry.title: CBO says Iran war driving up inflation, puts price tag at $38 billion
entry.summary: Two new, independent reports show detailed looks at the costs of the war in Iran. It's led to shortages in U.S. weapons, supply chain bottlenecks and a price tag in the tens of billions of dollars.

entry.title: Family income rose and poverty fell in 2025 — but safety net cuts could erase gains
entry.summary: An annual report from the Census Bureau shows the average family made more money in 2025 than the year before, while the official poverty rate declined. Health care coverage was little changed from 2024.

entry.title: A Trump-backed crypto bill just suffered a bruising defeat in the Senate. Here's why
entry.summary: The legislation was intended to establish rules of the road for the crypto sector for the first time. But it suffered a stinging defeat in the Senate on Tuesday.

entry.title: Get ready for yet another cost when buying a home: Junk fees
entry.summary: Some real estate agents and researchers say home buyers and sellers should not pay this out-of-pocket fee.

entry.title: The powerful millionaires hiding in plain sight
entry.summary: They own car dealerships, law firms, dental practices, and restaurant chains. Collectively, these overlooked business owners hold far more wealth than the Forbes 400 — and wield considerable political power.

entry.title: A new tax incentive could lead to more films being made in the U.S. rather than abroad
entry.summary: President Trump and Congress are weighing in on potential federal tax incentives for film production. It's hoped the tax credit would keep production of films and TV in the U.S. rather than overseas.

entry.title: Anthropic and OpenAI CEOs call for AI development to slow down, OpenAI to delay IPO
entry.summary: Dario Amodei and Sam Altman are the latest to urge caution amid fears the industry is racing too fast to build powerful AI while safety measures lag.
